notes: Settings for the classification call. The system prompt is config/classifier-prompt.md; workflows/build.js places both into the workflow, and every classified row records `version` as prompt_version.

The response schema is not written here. build-classification-request.js generates it from `contract` in config/routing-rules.json on every call, so the schema, the validator and the rules share one vocabulary.

`fallbacks` opts into the API's server-side refusal fallback, which needs the `beta` header on the request. A declined request is re-run on another model inside the same call, so model_name on the row is read from the response, not from `model`.
